reviewFlags.issue: Retailer pages disagree: the ZAP spec line says 1,780 W, while the ZAP and Wisebuy descriptions say 1760 W. The EU variant SFP700EU page also says 1.780 W. Confirm the Israeli value.

Width 38 cm, height 40 cm and depth 31 cm appear on Wisebuy, but the lines could not be quoted as one exact-model evidence item, so no dimensions fact was submitted. The only full dimension line found is for the EU variant SFP700EU, which was not used.
No warranty length found on an exact-model Israeli page. Other regional variants list 1 to 3 years, so the Israeli warranty is unverified.
Regional variants SFP700UK, SFP700EU and SFP700ME exist. The Israeli variant is assumed from Israeli listings that name SFP700 only. The catalog name is not changed here.
Power differs between sources (1760 W in descriptions vs 1,780 W on ZAP spec line and EU page). Confirm the Israeli value.
Regional variants SFP700EU/UK/ME exist; the Israeli variant suffix is not confirmed.
Warranty length not found on an Israeli exact-model page.
